full_prompt_en: A square, richly patterned painted illustration places a woman's face among a dense field of flowers, leaves, and circular motifs, with saturated jewel colors filling almost every part of the background. The face occupies the left half and turns nearly forward, framed by a smooth mass of black hair that curves around her forehead and cheeks. Her large green eyes, narrow dark brows, softly blushed cheeks, and small red mouth are simplified into clean, balanced shapes. Warm cream and golden orange areas model the face with gentle transitions, while fine grain keeps its surface from looking flat. At the upper edge, oversized blossoms and concentric circles press close to the hair, merging the figure with the surrounding ornament. On the right, layered petals, oval leaves, and patterned disks overlap in changing scales. Their stems and small dotted marks fill the gaps, so little plain ground remains visible. Across the lower area, the clothing and adjacent decorative shapes are divided into bright patches of red, emerald, turquoise, yellow, and violet. Tiny speckles, repeated curves, and crisp internal marks give each color area a handmade, textile-like density. The outline of the face remains clear against the crowded field because its warm, comparatively quiet planes contrast with the small, high-contrast patterns around it. Light feels even and internal to the color rather than cast from a directional source; shallow shading gives the cheeks and eyes a little volume without interrupting the flattened ornamental space. The overall composition balances a calm, frontal focal form with restless multicolored detail and an exuberant decorative rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、纹样丰沛的绘画插图把一张女子面容置于花朵、叶片和圆形图案的密集区域中，饱和的宝石色填满背景的几乎每一处。面容占据左半边，近乎正面朝前，乌黑而平滑的发块环绕额头和双颊。她的大绿色眼睛、细窄深眉、轻泛红晕的脸颊和小巧红唇被简化成干净而均衡的形状。暖奶油色与金橙色以柔和过渡塑造面部，细小颗粒又使表面不显得平板。上缘的大朵花和同心圆紧贴头发，使人物与周围装饰融为一体。右侧的层叠花瓣、椭圆叶片和带纹圆盘以不断变化的尺度互相覆盖。花茎与细小点纹填充间隙，几乎看不到素净的底色。下方的衣着和相邻装饰形状被切分成红、翠绿、青蓝、黄和紫的明亮色块。细密斑点、重复曲线与清楚的内部纹路，让各色区域具有手工织物般的密度。面容轮廓在拥挤背景中依旧明确，因为它温暖且相对安静的平面与周围细小、高反差的图案形成对比。光线仿佛均匀地存在于色彩内部，而非来自明确的方向；浅浅的阴影给予脸颊和眼睛少许体积，又不打断扁平的装饰空间。整体构图以平静的正面焦点形体平衡躁动的多彩细节，形成欢腾的装饰节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image is a densely ornamental painted illustration built from interlocking flat color shapes and exceptionally busy internal pattern. Saturated red, emerald, turquoise, golden yellow, violet, and near-black meet in abrupt but controlled boundaries; quieter warm planes create breathing points within the color pressure. Rounded contours and repeated concentric curves set a flowing rhythm, while tiny dots, stippling, and short marks lend the surfaces a textile-like grain. Main silhouettes stay bold and readable despite the close-packed decoration, and nested motifs shift scale to keep the eye moving across the frame. Lighting is broad and even, with only shallow tonal modeling, so contrast comes chiefly from adjacent colors and from differences in pattern density. Foreground and background overlap without deep perspective, producing a compressed, tapestry-like space. The overall effect is vivid, intimate, and exuberantly handmade.
style_prompt_zh: 图像是由相互咬合的平面色块和极为繁密的内部纹样构成的装饰性绘画插图。饱和的红、翠绿、青蓝、金黄、紫和近黑色以突然而受控的边界相接；较安静的暖色平面在强烈色压中形成透气点。圆润轮廓与重复同心曲线建立流动节奏，细点、点描和短线让表面带有织物般的颗粒。主要剪影在紧密装饰中仍然鲜明可辨，套叠图案通过尺度变化引导目光游走。光线宽泛均匀，只有浅浅的色调塑形，因此反差主要来自相邻色彩及纹样密度的差异。前后形体互相覆盖而缺乏深透视，形成压缩的挂毯式空间。整体效果鲜艳、亲密，并带有欢腾的手工感。
theme_en: A woman's face among densely patterned flowers
theme_zh: 繁密花纹中的女子面容
name: Pacita Abad
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
